exampleResolvedDraws.note: The B variants from the Jax proposal, kept here as ILLUSTRATIVE resolved draws (what a seed could produce), not as fixed teams. In randomized mode the actual draw comes from the seed below.

excludedFromVariation: falk (locked team, no pool — stays fixed in both modes)
lin (single in-code team, no pool defined — stays fixed in both modes)
all carry-over route/acolyte/grunt teams in fixed-teams.json (no pools defined — stay fixed in both modes)
mysterious-figure-form teams (Luigi's pool is a separate, not-yet-built proposal — not staged here)
fallbackTeam: The trainer's fixed-default team from fixed-teams.json, used ONLY if the pool is exhausted after the rules below. The fallback is itself inside the locked theme pool for Jax (its fixed picks are pool species or mainstays).
rules: 1. Mainstays are fixed: the trainer's locked mainstays appear in every draw, at the evolution stage that fight point requires.
2. Pool slots draw ONLY from that trainer's locked theme/type pool. No off-theme species ever enters a pool slot.
3. No duplicates, no same-line doubles in a resolved team (except the mainstay line itself, which appears once, at its current stage).
4. Levels are fixed per fight point; species vary. No level jitter unless Mars approves it.
5. Seed = (saveFileId, trainerId, fightPoint). Same save, same team, every time. New game, new save ID, new draw. No daily seed, no time-of-day seed, no re-roll on retry.
6. Resolve once, store in the save. First meeting at that fight point draws, stores the resolved party, and never redraws it for that save. Losing and retrying does NOT reroll.
7. Pool exhaustion falls back, never crashes: use the documented fallbackTeam for missing slots, in order.
8. Mars approves the system, not the slots. He may veto any single species from a pool at any time; it leaves all future draws.
